product.title: Waikiki Luau Buffet with Optional Rock-A-Hula Show Ticket

description.text: The Waikiki Luau pairs a buffet of suckling pig and roast beef with the onsite Rock-a-Hula show. The evening starts with a Hawaiian welcome and a mai tai. Rock-a-Hula includes hula, fire-knife dancing, and rock and roll, and admission to that show comes with select packages. Whole suckling pig and roast beef are on the buffet at this luau in Waikiki, on Oahu. Select packages add Rock-a-Hula admission, with hula, fire-knife dancing, and rock and roll after the welcome mai tai and the Waikiki buffet.
